scope: Translate Help.tscn Default Controls + Challenge Ladders and CraftingHelp.tscn crafting options.

patches.old_text:
bbcode_text = "[center]Default Controls[/center]

Movement:
WASD, Mouse Left Click, Gamepad Joystick, D-PAD

Interact:
Spacebar, Gamepad A, Mouse Left Click

Dash/Dodge:
Shift, Xbox Layout B

Open Gene Loadout:
I, Xbox Layout Y

Open Character Sheet:
Escape, C

Some of these keybinds can be changed in the Settings menu.
"
patches.new_text:
bbcode_text = "[center]默认操作[/center]

移动：
WASD、鼠标左键、手柄摇杆、方向键

互动：
空格键、手柄 A、鼠标左键

冲刺/闪避：
Shift、Xbox 布局 B

打开基因配置：
I、Xbox 布局 Y

打开角色面板：
Escape、C

部分按键可以在设置菜单中修改。"

patches.old_text:
bbcode_text = "[center]Challenge Ladders[/center]

There are 4 Challenge Ladder zones, found at zone levels 25, 50, and 100.

Scoring for these ladders is as follows:

score = waves_completed * 10000 - time_elapsed_in_seconds

This means to get a higher score, beat waves faster!

Each wave in a ladder is equal to 20 zone levels in difficulty."
patches.new_text:
bbcode_text = "[center]挑战天梯[/center]

共有 4 个挑战天梯区域，分别位于区域等级 25、50 和 100。

这些天梯的计分方式如下：

分数 = 完成波数 * 10000 - 消耗秒数

想获得更高分数，就要更快地击败波次！

天梯中的每波敌人相当于 20 个区域等级的难度。"

patches.old_text:
bbcode_text = "[center]Crafting Options[/center]

[color=#53dfdf]Scramble[/color]: Reroll all non-locked mods on the Item.

[color=#53dfdf]Lucky Scramble[/color]: Reroll all non-locked mods on the Item, and rolls for tiers 2 times, taking the best outcome.

[color=#53dfdf]Godly Scramble[/color]: Reroll all non-locked mods on the Item, and rolls for tiers 10 times, taking the best outcome.

[color=#53dfdf]Store[/color]: Moves the mods from the Item to be stored for Recombination

[color=#53dfdf]Restore[/color]: Moves stored mods back to the Item, overwriting the Item.

[color=#53dfdf]Recombinate[/color]: Randomly combines the stored mods onto the Item. This resulting Item mods will be a mix of the stored mods and Item mods. Removes the stored mods. Both stored and Item mods must have at least 2 prefixes and 2 suffixes each.

[color=#53dfdf]Reroll Mod Values[/color]: Reroll the numeric values of the mods within their respective Mod Level

[color=#53dfdf]Upgrade Random Mod[/color]: Increase the Mod Level for a random non-locked, non-maxed mod.
"
patches.new_text:
bbcode_text = "[center]工艺选项[/center]

[color=#53dfdf]洗练[/color]：重掷物品上所有未锁定的修饰属性。

[color=#53dfdf]幸运洗练[/color]：重掷物品上所有未锁定的修饰属性，并掷 2 次阶层，取最佳结果。

[color=#53dfdf]神圣洗练[/color]：重掷物品上所有未锁定的修饰属性，并掷 10 次阶层，取最佳结果。

[color=#53dfdf]存储[/color]：将物品上的修饰属性移出，为重组做准备。

[color=#53dfdf]恢复[/color]：将存储的修饰属性移回物品，覆盖物品。

[color=#53dfdf]重组[/color]：将存储的修饰属性随机组合到物品上。重组后的物品修饰属性是存储修饰与物品修饰的混合。重组会移除已存储的修饰。存储修饰与物品修饰都必须至少各有 2 个前缀和 2 个后缀。

[color=#53dfdf]重掷修饰数值[/color]：在各自修饰等级范围内重掷修饰的数值。

[color=#53dfdf]升级随机修饰[/color]：提升一个随机未锁定、未满级修饰的修饰等级。"
